'''Daalang''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] on the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], near [[Attahox/Legends|Attahox]].

==History==
{{Quote|You were supposed to be escorting me to the ''Rebels''{{'}} Trade Conference on Daalang. That's important, Solo... That's people's ''lives''!|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TPE">{{StoryCite|story=The Pandora Effect|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151}}</ref>}}
Daalang joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prior to the [[Indecta Era]]. During the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], it supported [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] came from [[Nixor/Legends|Nixor]] and [[Battle of the Daalang system (Great Sith War)|conquered]] the planet, from which they moved to [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]]. Decades later, during the [[Jedi Civil War]], the planet was the site of a [[Battle of the Daalang system (Jedi Civil War)|battle]] won by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[New Sith Wars|New Sith War]], [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] corps dispatched a task force to Dalaang but the mission was a failure. The survivors, who became known later as [[Devil Squadron]], were captured and enslaved for several years by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord [[Zodoh]] after the inhabitants refused to shelter them.<ref name="KED">''[[Star Wars: Knight Errant: Deluge]]''</ref>

In the Clone Wars, the CIS stationed an [[Anti-orbital cannon|anti-orbital]] [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannon]]. The shields of the CIS base were destroyed by [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]], clearing the path for the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Eliminator (Clone Wars)|''Eliminator'']] to [[Battle of Daalang|attack]] the CIS base hidden in the nebula surrounding the body.<ref name="GaW" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Daalang hosted a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebels' Trade Conference|trade conference]].<ref name="TPE" />

Daalang was a stronghold of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Hunt for Zsinj]], which took place between [[7 ABY/Legends|7]] and [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] and the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of the Daalang system|invaded]] the planet shortly after arriving in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TEA" />
